verify: python -m pip install -e '.[dev]' 2>/dev/null || pip install -r requirements.txt

idioms: Detect the package manager from lockfiles (poetry.lock / uv.lock / Pipfile.lock / requirements.txt) and use only that one.
Match the client's type-hint discipline: if the codebase is typed, every new function is typed; if not, don't retrofit.
Use the client's test runner and fixture style (pytest fixtures vs unittest setUp) — detect from existing tests.
Respect pyproject.toml tool config (ruff/black/mypy sections) exactly.
prompt_pack.pr_style: Match existing PR titles in the client repo. Default: imperative summary, link their issue.
never: Never pin or upgrade dependencies unless that IS the task.
Never add a new formatter/linter to a client repo.
